views.signature: void Original_texture_dimensions(void * dib, float memoryFraction, bool powerOfTwo, int * width, int * height)

abiCorrection.sourceArgument2: float memoryFraction in XMM1, saved to XMM6. Upload caller loads MOVSS from runtime global0x1415c7ec8. The maximum selector uses global current-context state, no source dib argument.

observations.maximum: Current context record caches max texture dimension at+0x28; if -1 queries glGetIntegerv0xd33. Missing context emits ON_ErrorEx and queries directly.
observations.dimensions: Ceil powers individually; choose limit if ceil exceeds maximum, else original or ceil dependingflag. If only one axis changed, ceil the other unchanged axis even if flagfalse. BytesPerPixel=max rule: depth<24 ->3, else depth>>3. uint32 byte estimate divided by uint32 runtime memory budget using single-precision; while ratio>memoryFraction halve both signed dimensions.
observations.alpha: Source bitmap must32bit and both DIB DCs valid. x lookup uses trunc(double x * sourceWidth/destWidth), y uses same ratio in stored row order. Destination pixel OR source pixel &0xff000000; existing nonzero alpha is not overwritten. RGB untouched. Top-down logical adapter must reverse row indices, not use ordinary nearest top-down sampling.
